title: Sable and the Provision
author: C. M. Crane
blurb: Ulyana Dravenmoor, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
